datePolicy: All 23 source-specific access dates are explicitly recorded as November 6, 2026 Singapore/Dubai local date in the original source ledger; some original fetches carry November 5 UTC. Localization on November 6 is not a source refresh. No publication date invented and no external re-research performed. Listing ages remain relative displays, not inferred publication dates.

listingSnapshots.caveat: Advertised: AED3,000 deposit; 5% commission + 5% VAT on that fee; AED1,575/year admin; AED210 Ejari. That Ejari quote differs from DLD’s AED177.75 / AED220 channel totals—get an itemised explanation. URL says Building 4; page says Building 1. Verify exact unit. “Walking distance to Metro” is advertiser wording.
Advertises “near Metro”; measure the actual walk. Partly furnished is not move-in-ready by default. Other charges need an itemised quote.
Metro walking access unverified. Do not pick it on the area name alone. Other charges need an itemised quote.

Advertised: 5% security deposit; 5% agency fee + VAT; AED840 admin (period not stated); chiller free. Confirm percentage bases, VAT and exactly which cooling charges are covered. “Close to Metro” is not a measured walk.
Cheque terms unverified. Metro walk and extra charges need checking.

Advertised: 5% deposit; 5% agency fee + VAT; AED300 Ejari (above DLD channel totals—ask what is included). “Chiller Included in DEWA” does not mean free cooling or utilities included in rent. No gym/pool; maintenance-free claim subject to contract. Metro walk unverified.
One cheque means AED60,000 rent upfront, before deposits/fees. Description says 322.70 sqft versus field 322. Furnished deposit may be higher; no March availability promise.
Small furnished studio near the budget ceiling. Confirm rent for the chosen cheque count and separate cooling/deposit costs.
Check the Sobha Realty walking route, cooling costs and furnished deposit.
“Multiple” does not mean twelve. Confirm exact payment schedule, deposit and cooling terms.

Advertises “Chiller Free”; confirm the lease covers the relevant cooling charges, not all electricity. Appliances do not mean a furnished flat. Check inventory/condition. Deposit, agency/admin and Ejari amounts not stated.
DMCC first mile may be substantial. Check an actual walking route or price a feeder/taxi; do not assume station-side living.

uncertainties: November 2026 advertisements are not March 2027 reservations. No agent contact, viewing, ownership/broker authentication or actual commute measurement; exact Business Bay office entrance unknown.

Pre-ID application consideration is not annual-lease acceptance, Ejari completion or handover. Dubai Residential and Vacationer policies are provider-specific; bank eligibility is not immediate cheque-book access.
No unit-specific rental-index result obtained. New-lease indicative role differs from renewal; legal inputs must be rechecked before signing. Not legal advice.
AED 72,000 unfurnished/four-cheque model is not a listing quote. Equal annual rent across cheque options assumed; deposits and commission are market norms, not statutory fixed tariffs.

DEWA official AED 155 small-meter fees take precedence over older secondary AED 130. Ejari official AED 177.75/AED 220 differs from provider AED 214.50, A1 AED 210 and B3 AED 300 quotes; itemisation needed.
A1 URL Building 4 versus page Building 1 retained; C1 size field 322 versus description 322.70 sqft retained. Cheque field/description differences retained, with no undocumented twelve-cheque offer.

Temporary stay AED 7,750, furniture, cooling deposits and monthly non-rent spending are estimates. Extra admin/connection fees, actual utility use, travel, debt/remittances, health gaps and employer-unpaid relocation/visa/medical/ID costs excluded or unpriced. Payroll timing/HR support unconfirmed.

First-year cash flow includes twelve salaries, March temporary stay, eleven occupied flat months, all four annual cheques including March 2028 prepaid rent, tied-up deposits and no assumed refunds. Opening rent is not double-counted.

English-only, so bilingual literal/table parity is not applicable. All headline displays appear verbatim in English. No booking, contact, payment, publication, source-run edit or shared build/inventory change.
